At x = 2 the two straight lines intersect, so the two sides are equal; when x > 2, the rising line y = ax is above the descending line y = bx + 5, so ax > bx + 5; when x < 2, the rising line is below the descending line, so ax < bx + 5. Therefore the solution set of the inequality is x ≥ 2.

method.method_draft: Use direct graphical comparison. First read the graph: the two lines meet at point A, and the dashed vertical from A drops to the x-axis at x = 2. The line y = ax is the rising line through the origin, and y = bx + 5 is the falling line. To solve ax >= bx + 5, compare which graph has the larger y-value. At x = 2 they are equal; for x-values to the right of 2, the rising line lies above the falling line, while for x-values to the left it lies below. Therefore the solution set is x >= 2.

method.method_draft: Use an algebraic reconstruction from the graph. Read from the image that the intersection occurs at x = 2, and that y = bx + 5 is the decreasing line while y = ax is the increasing line, so a - b > 0. At the intersection, ax = bx + 5, so substituting x = 2 gives 2a = 2b + 5, hence 2(a - b) = 5. The inequality ax >= bx + 5 becomes (a - b)x >= 5. Since a - b > 0 and 2(a - b) = 5, dividing by the positive number a - b gives x >= 2.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有直角坐标系，两条直线相交于点 A。一条直线过原点并向右上方倾斜，对应 y=ax；另一条直线向右下方倾斜，对应 y=bx+5。点 A 的竖直虚线落在 x 轴的刻度 2 处，所以交点的横坐标为 x=2。推理：因为 y=ax 是增函数而 y=bx+5 是减函数，所以 a-b>0。在交点处 ax=bx+5。代入交点横坐标 x=2，得 2a=2b+5，即 2(a-b)=5。原不等式 ax>=bx+5 可化为 (a-b)x>=5。由于 a-b>0，可以同向除以 a-b，得到 x>=5/(a-b)。又由 2(a-b)=5 可知 5/(a-b)=2，所以解集为 x>=2。
